== Notes ==
* Combines well with both long-lasting and spammable enchantments, e.g. [[flash enchantment]], [[Orders build]]s, or several [[Wind Prayers]] skills that rely on multiple enchantments (e.g. [[Mystic Healing]] and [[Dwayna's Touch]]).
* This spell counts the number of enchantments you have ''before'' you finish casting your current spell. For example, if your only enchantment is Arcane Zeal, casting [[Featherfoot Grace]] only returns 2 energy.
